newsitem.title: USA: CCC SEEKS 3,945 TONNES SUNOIL FOR BOSNIA/GEORGIA.
newsitem.headline: CCC SEEKS 3,945 TONNES SUNOIL FOR BOSNIA/GEORGIA.

text.p: The Commodity Credit Corp of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it will tender on August 18 to buy 3,945 tonnes of refined sunflowerseed oil for donation to Bosnia and Georgia.
CCC seeks 2,695 tonnes of sunoil for Georgia and 1,250 tonnes of sunoil for Bosnia.
Shipment periods for both parcels are identical, with dates of Oct 6-20 for suppliers with inland plants or Oct 19-Nov 3 for suppliers with plants at ports.
Distribution agency for both parcels is United Methodist Committee on Relief (UMCOR), CCC said.
